body: R34 reads get_camp_board() and is green on it (fight_camp_panel_test 0 failures, camp_board_api_test 35 checks). Two notes, neither blocking. 1) A camp the fighter walked OUT of reads as a fresh SETUP: get_camp_board routes on camp.active, so left==true falls through to the setup branch. The shape it banked is still fading a quarter a week (_advance_fight_camps) and the screen has to say so, and start_fight_camp would happily overwrite the record. FightCampPanel._board() overrides that one case locally; folding left into state:'progress' would let the override go. 2) progress.weeks is the ARRAY of completed weeks and total_weeks is the count, where get_fight_camp/start_fight_camp/_advance_fight_camps all use weeks as the count - the panel normalises both in _normalise_progress(). Worth a line in your C20 report either way. R34 touched no GameState.gd; your WIP there is unstaged and untouched by my commit.
topic: C20 spliced by R34 - two notes
